page.notes: The catchword "gibus" completes the word "legibus" from the last line. The marginal note reads "l. 2. in fin. Cod. comm. de leg." across three short lines in the left margin. The word "præ-notabo" is printed with a soft break; I read it as "præ notabo" and transcribed it as "præ-notabo", but the line-break hyphen is uncertain. The "-" marks at the top right corner and the faint marks at the bottom are scan edges and were left out.
